title: The semiclassical limit of unit-area quantum disks
summary: Fix $W\in(0,2)$ and let $γ\downarrow0$. We prove that a weight-$W$ quantum disk conditioned to have unit quantum area converges, in the maximum-embedded strip, to the deterministic field $φ_W(t+iθ)=\log(W/(4π))-2\log\cosh(Wt/2)$ and its constant-curvature area measure. The proof establishes a joint large-deviation principle for the radial Brownian input, the lateral Gaussian free field, and the total Gaussian multiplicative chaos mass.
